text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've just about adjusted to<n>life at Tracen,
I figure it's time to find<n>myself a trainee. I'm
walking around<n>campus one day, when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A student bites me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Tehe... Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHAHA! Look at you! Look<n>how shocked
you are!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What?! You... don't know Windy?<n>How dare you!
You should think twice<n>before disrespectin' me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Standin' before ya is the evil<n>genius, wicked
overlord, demonic<n>world hegemon—Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Neeheehee! Remember the name!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since then, I've been ambushed by a
jack-in-the-box...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huhuhu...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HYAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lured into a pit...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe... AHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And generally subjected to all<n>manner of pranks by
Shinko Windy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Neeheehee! You fool! You fool! That<n>cream puff has
mustard in it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Do you feel it? The fear! The shock<n>and awe!
Windy's too much for ya to<n>handle, isn't she?
Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Wait a second. Why're ya crying?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Does it really hurt? Bah, you're<n>hopeless!
Drink this. It's normal<n>water. No bubbles, I promise.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don't thank me yet! A true<n>mastermind toys with
her prey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna nurse you back to health,<n>and then...
GAWRRR! Heeheehee,<n>that's the Wicked Windy
way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I go to watch a<n>scrimmage only to
find Shinko Windy<n>in the running.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I almost don't recognize her. The<n>prankster I'd met
has been replaced<n>by a prowling predator, eyeing
her<n>chance to pounce.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfazed by the dirt flying into her<n>face, she weaves
through the pack<n>with single-minded focus. For a
split<n>second I'm wholly convinced of her<n>imminent
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And they're into the stretch! Shinko<n>Windy makes
her move! She<n>challenges the leader—just 200
meters to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What happened? As soon as she hits<n>the stretch,
her eyes lose focus,<n>flitting this way and that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Grrr! Cheeky little—why won't she<n>get out of the
way?!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Not again, not again! It's the same<n>as last time!
Someone always gets in<n>the way... Shut up, shut up!
The<n>footsteps, the cheers—I can't think!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(No one in the crowd's even lookin'<n>my way! Now
I'm pissed. I can't<n>focus. I won't reach. Not like
this, not<n>at this rate...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GAHHH! Not like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Runner
text_block_list.text: KYAH?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sh-Shinko Windy? Is that a penalty<n>for Shinko
Windy?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We have a verdict: the race results<n>will remain
unchanged. Shinko Windy<n>will receive a severe
warning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Windy takes second place.<n>Her bite
actually drove the leader to<n>speed up and edge her
out by a neck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing praiseworthy about<n>foul play. But
the fixation on victory<n>she displayed in that
desperate move<n>left an impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to say. As I'm<n>fumbling for
words...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flummoxed by the sudden attack, I<n>end up in a
speechless staring<n>contest with Windy for a few
seconds.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hehehe! You looked, you<n>looked! Ya looked
right at me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAHAHAHA! Made you look!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Come and catch me if you can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she gleefully scampers<n>away. I
guess I should follow her.
choice_data_list: (Wasn't she feeling down just a moment ago?!)
(Wasn't she feeling down just a moment ago?!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's as if the race never happened.<n>The look on her
cackling face as she<n>runs off is one of pure joy.
